name: Ethan Page
profileSummary: Julian Micevski, better known by his ring name Ethan Page, is a Canadian professional wrestler. He is signed to WWE, where he performs on the Raw brand. He is a former one-time and longest-reigning NXT North American Champion, and a former one-time NXT Champion. He also makes appearances for WWE's partner promotion Lucha Libre AAA Worldwide (AAA), where he is a former one-time AAA World Mixed Tag Team Champion with Chelsea Green.
